title:
Epic that adds the selected {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s from the `CaseDetailAlertsTabSuggestedOpenAlertsGrid`
to the current {@link ReliabilityAssetCase} on the Asset Case Detail Page.
Adding these alerts to the case will also trigger an update to the `CaseDetailAlertsTabGrid`.

This epic uses the `getConfigFromState` function to retrieve the `selectedItemIds` field
from the `CaseDetailAlertsTabSuggestedOpenAlertsGrid` configuration.
name: AddAlertsToCaseEpic
